name: DIE LAST
detailed_description:
Stay tuned


About the Game




Plant Trees

Trees are a giver of life — plant them to earn Karma and revive the ground that turned vile after the old order poisoned it. Karma runs everything. Every move you make, every action you take, costs Karma. The larger your Forest, the more Karma you will receive

Find Lost Objects

As you wander, you will find Lost Objects from the old order. Use them to craft cryptic messages. The messages you send and receive can give special powers, offer unexpected opportunities, or devastate you or another player with their cruelty

Create DeBots

DeBots are your trusted companions. Design them yourself with different properties, and they will give you the power to build, defend yourself, or attack and steal another player’s Karma. But make sure your DeBots get enough sleep, or else they will become weak

Build Pipes

Build Pipes to transport Karma. Connect Pipes to a Forest or a Factory, and give yourself the power to go off to wander to where no man has gone before. Wherever you go, your pipes will also transport your DeBots

Steal Karma

Any player can attack any pipe they see and steal the Karma with the help of a DeBot. But you also have to use pipes to transport stolen Karma. And because any player can stand in a Forest and send Karma to any Pipe connected to it, there’s a lot of it going around

Defend Yourself

Every decision you make has to be strategic — defend yourself from other players' attacks by watching out for pipes going in your direction. And prepare yourself for Acki Nacki, dangerous creatures with sharp teeth. They will attack random players at random times, and fight them for Karma

Join Guilds

Join a Guild to earn a steady supply of Karma. They are alliances of players that run abandoned Factories producing blocks of Karma. Be warned, other Guilds might attack you. But you can also earn Karma in addition to the supply of a Guild by planting your own forests, or you can go rogue.

Go Rogue

Rogue players are not a part of any Guild. They wander with their best friend — their Dog — and battle and steal other players' Karma, and survive any which way they can, growing stronger with each successful fight.

Participate in Tournaments

Play in Die Last Tournaments — periodically organized bouts between Guilds where the aim is to stay alive. Tournaments happen in different Zones that are always far away and randomly selected. And they are lucrative, with the winners earning massive quantities of Karma from the Prize Pool.

Spy On Your Competitors

Any player can buy a Spy DeBot for 1 mission. It will give you analytics about other players and Guilds, and if you have enough, you get real time notifications about the game, and the ability to kill another Spy DeBot. The catch? Other players know you’re spying on them.

Communicate With Other Players

You can write a letter to any other player or Guild. If you step into the same square, or wander into a Forest or a Building, a chat will open up allowing you to instantly talk with another player. We cannot survive in, and revive, this world alone.

“The creation of a single world comes from a huge number of fragments and chaos.”
― Hayao Miyazaki

short_description: We must revive this post-industrial world. Plant trees to earn Karma, build pipes, join Guilds, and participate in league tournaments to stay alive. Find lost objects to craft secret messages. Go rogue, wander with your dog, steal other players' Karma and grow stronger with every battle

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: A quad-core CPU running at 3GHz or higher
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: A DirectX 11 compatible video card with 2GB of VRAM or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

  • OS: macOS 10.14 Mojave or higher
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
